verdict.rationale: Paperspace documents a pre-built "ML in a Box" machine template that comes preinstalled with the major ML frameworks and CUDA drivers. That covers the PyTorch/CUDA part of the story, and machine creation lets you pick a template. However, the evidence shows only this single generic template, and custom templates are user-made snapshots rather than pre-built ones. missing for 10: dedicated vLLM and ComfyUI templates, an explicit PyTorch-specific template listing or catalog of multiple pre-built images, independent hands-on corroboration of template launch.

support.subject: As a developer, I can launch from pre-built ML templates (PyTorch, CUDA, vLLM, ComfyUI) instead of assembling an environment from scratch

citations.quote: Choose "ML in a Box" template that comes preinstalled with all the major ML frameworks and CUDA® drivers.
When you create a new machine, you choose your machine type, operating system or custom template
